shock: original observed high-frequency monetary and information surprises
mandatory_dynamics: all twelve endogenous lag coefficients in every equation
optional: original nuisance dictionary without lagged exogenous shock products
penalty: same centered quarterly-HAC plugin PDS penalty as the LP
response: conditional on fixed future fiscal states and zero further exogenous innovations
inference: joint multiequation HAC(12), complex-step delta method
support: exact common country-quarter rows for all LP benchmarks and the VARX
